2607.08080.title: MASTE: A Multi-Agent Pipeline for Zero-Shot Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction
2607.08080.paper_summary: Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction (ASTE) requires jointly identifying (aspect, opinion, sentiment) triples from a given review sentence. While large language models (LLMs) achieve strong zero-shot performance on many NLP benchmarks, their effectiveness on ASTE remains limited, as single-pass generation forces the model to determine span boundaries, opinion grouping, and sentiment polarity in a single decoding step. Common remedies, such as few-shot in-context learning and chain-of-thought prompting, offer only marginal improvements and rely heavily on either in-domain demonstrations sampled from labeled training data or carefully engineered reasoning prompts, neither of which is broadly available in zero-shot deployment. Inspired by the classical agent paradigm, we propose MASTE, a multi-agent pipeline for zero-shot Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction. MASTE decomposes ASTE into four sequential stages, where specialized agents handle different compositional subtasks with explicit conditioning on prior outputs. This design enables entirely training-free zero-shot ASTE and generalizes across different backbones and datasets. Extensive experiments on four ASTE benchmarks show that MASTE substantially outperforms zero-shot and chain-of-thought LLM baselines under the same backbone, narrowing the gap to fully supervised methods without using any labeled triplets. Code is available at https://github.com/Hankerlove/MASTE.
2607.08080.paper_summary_zh: 方面情感三元組提取（ASTE）需要從給定的評價句子中共同識別（方面、意見、情感）三元組。雖然大型語言模型（LLMs）在許多 NLP 基準上達到了強大的零樣本性能，但它們在 ASTE 上的有效性仍然有限，因為單次生成迫使模型在單一解碼步驟中確定範圍邊界、意見分組和情感極性。常見的解決方案，如少量上下文學習和思維鏈提示，只提供邊際改善，並且在很大程度上依賴於從標記訓練數據中抽樣的領域內示範或精心設計的推理提示，這兩者在零樣本部署中都不廣泛可用。受到經典代理範式的啟發，我們提出了 MASTE，一個用於零樣本方面情感三元組提取的多代理管道。MASTE 將 ASTE 分解為四個連續階段，專門的代理處理不同的組合子任務，並對先前的輸出進行明確的條件化。這一設計使得完全無需訓練的零樣本 ASTE 成為可能，並在不同的骨幹和數據集之間進行泛化。在四個 ASTE 基準上的廣泛實驗表明，MASTE 在相同骨幹下顯著超越了零樣本和思維鏈 LLM 基線，縮小了與完全監督方法之間的差距，而不使用任何標記的三元組。代碼可在 https://github.com/Hankerlove/MASTE 獲得。
